# public/icons/

Placeholder for the Tauri icon set.

## Before the first build

Generate the full icon set from a source image (1024x1024 PNG recommended):

```bash
pnpm tauri icon path/to/source.png
```

This command generates all required sizes (32x32, 128x128, 128x128@2x, .icns, .ico, .png variants) and places them in `src-tauri/icons/`.

The `tauri.conf.json` `bundle.icon` array points at `icons/*.{png,icns,ico}` — update those paths if you reorganize.

## Required files (generated by `pnpm tauri icon`)

- `32x32.png`
- `128x128.png`
- `128x128@2x.png`
- `icon.icns` (macOS)
- `icon.ico` (Windows)
- `icon.png` (Linux, AppImage)
